text:
matt d: Quick sync: we need a lean observability MVP for console — dashboards, tracing hooks (minimal), per-route cost export, and canary gates. Customers asking for route spend and error slices.

anya: MVP proposal: 1) Dashboards: overview (latency/cost/error trend) + route cost table. 2) Tracing: inject trace_id + single model-selection span. 3) Export: CSV per-route & model-version. 4) Gates: 72h canary, P95 <= +10% baseline, error delta <= +0.5pp.

sofia: Runtime tracing is the blocker; estimate ~2 sprint-weeks for end-to-end. Dashboards are mostly frontend wiring.

jordan: For Dedicated/private default to anonymized traces; full payload behind opt-in. Must document residency/KMS. Feature flag per-org.

customer-success: Finance asks for CSV export and a tag flow so product teams can map spend. Scheduled exports are a nice-to-have.

anya: We'll add `/api/v1/costs/export?start=&end=&tag=` and a tagging modal. Schedule exports -> backlog.

matt d: Rollout: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 72h with auto-rollback. Add Prometheus canary alert.

deploy-bot: scheduled staging deploy: obs/trace-hooks @ 2026-04-02T09:00:00Z

sofia: Will post staging demo when traces appear.

matt d: Owners: Sofia (tracing + API), Anya (dashboards + UI), Jordan (flags/rollout/alerts). Reconvene Thu to finalize acceptance.

anya: Acceptance checklist: instrumentation in staging, dashboards with sample data, CSV matches billing <1%, canary automation + rollback tested, docs + security review done.

matt d: If urgent cuts needed: prefer to drop full-trace opt-in and ship anonymized traces, keep cost and overview dashboards. Shout by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
